title: Pairwise replay report for the default Advisor finance intent
headline: On the generated 100-task finance corpus, deepseek-v4-flash is +2.0 pp over minimax-m3 on pass^1 (39/100 vs 37/100), but the paired bootstrap 95% CI crosses zero [-8.0, +12.0] pp.
condition: live-generated corpus, yfinance finance-tools scope, 100 tasks, attempts_per_task=1, metric=pass^1; corpus generated with kimi-k2p7 and evaluated on deepseek-v4-flash vs minimax-m3 through Hydra

effect_sizes.label: deepseek-v4-flash - minimax-m3 on generated finance corpus
planned MDE for 100 unique paired tasks
baseline Wilson CI width at p=0.5 for 100 tasks

missingness.policy: combined full pairwise eval: 100 common task ids x 2 candidate models; duplicate stop/resume rows were deduplicated before combining

multiplicity.policy: one primary paired comparison with exploratory slice diagnostics
multiplicity.note: The primary paired delta uses task-level bootstrap over the 100 common generated tasks. Slice rows are descriptive and not separately powered confirmatory tests.

allowed_claims: Scoped pairwise comparison for deepseek-v4-flash vs minimax-m3 on the generated 100-task finance/yfinance corpus.
deepseek-v4-flash is observed at 39/100 pass^1 and minimax-m3 at 37/100 pass^1.
The observed +2.0 pp deepseek-minus-minimax delta is statistically inconclusive under the paired bootstrap interval.
The planned no-prior MDE for 100 unique paired tasks is about 19.8 pp, so this run is not powered to resolve a small 2 pp gap.
not_allowed_claims: claim that deepseek-v4-flash is definitively better than minimax-m3
claim that minimax-m3 is definitively better than deepseek-v4-flash
universal best-model claim outside this finance/yfinance generated corpus
claim about pass^3 reliability; these evals used attempts_per_task=1

issues.message: The observed paired delta is small and the 95% bootstrap interval crosses zero.
issues.statistical_reason: Observed delta +2.0 pp is far below the 19.8 pp planning MDE for 100 unique tasks.
repair_options: Increase the task budget for a smaller detectable effect.
Report this as an inconclusive scoped demo comparison.

issues.message: The completed eval rows support pass^1, not pass^3 reliability.
issues.statistical_reason: Repeated attempts were not run for the combined full evals.
repair_options: Run three attempts per task for pass^3.
Keep the demo card labelled as pass^1.

provenance.corpus: data/advisor_runs/ba7_default_design_corpus_20260707_123630_combined100: 85 base tasks plus 15 selected top-up tasks; final depth mix short=21, medium=24, long=55; server yfinance/finance-tools.
provenance.execution: Hydra OpenAI-compatible routing; corpus generation models kimi-k2p7 for goal/explore/distill; eval models deepseek-v4-flash and minimax-m3; duplicate stop/resume rows deduplicated before final combine.
provenance.server_filter_note: All 100 combined tasks use the yfinance server under the finance-tools Advisor scope.

data_quality: Combined corpus contains 100 TaskSpecs and 100 reference traces: 85 from the base run plus 15 selected top-up tasks.
Final selected depth mix is short=21, medium=24, long=55; this is close to the requested 20/30/50 mix but medium remains under target because the top-up pool did not contain enough medium tasks.
Eval metric is pass^1 because attempts_per_task=1 was used for these completed full runs.
DeepSeek top-up and MiniMax base evals had stop/resume artifacts; final combined files use deduplicated first rows per task_id.
No SAE was recorded in either combined eval: 0/100 for both models.
